insights: The Jaeger trace (028ef016097347d3) shows the /wrk2-api/post/compose request ended with error=true and http.status_code=500 from nginx-thrift.
compose-post-service is in the trace call path for the compose flow; its client span (compose_post_client) shows very long durations, indicating blocking RPC attempts during the request.

compose-post-service logs contain numerous repeated Thrift 'TSocket::open() ... Connection refused' errors when connecting to text-service on port 9090 (ClientPool.h:114:Pop Failed to connect text-service-client), indicating immediate TCP refusals rather than timeouts.

text-service pod logs contain only a startup info line and no evidence it accepted connections or continued running; combined with the connection-refused errors this indicates text-service was not listening/available (down or crashed) at the time of the failures.

The failure chain is: text-service unavailable -> compose-post-service RPCs to text-service fail with 'Connection refused' -> compose flow fails and propagates error back to nginx-thrift -> nginx returns HTTP 500 to the client.
The problem is reproducible and sustained over the observed window (many repeated connection refusals), consistent with an outage of text-service rather than an intermittent network hiccup.

Confirmed hypotheses: (1) the trace would reveal the failing span/service (confirmed), (2) compose-post-service emitted RPC errors causing the compose flow to fail (confirmed), and (3) text-service was down/not accepting Thrift connections on port 9090 causing those RPC failures (confirmed).

args.diagnosis: compose-post-service is failing orchestration because it cannot connect to text-service (Thrift connection refused). This downstream connection failure leads compose-post-service to return HTTP 500 for /post/compose; the error is caused by text-service being down/unreachable, not by user-service.
args.reasoning: Trace 028ef016097347d3 shows the /wrk2-api/post/compose request ended with error=true and http.status_code=500 (top-level nginx spans). The compose-post-service spans are present in the trace but do not show internal errors; meanwhile compose-post-service logs contain repeated Thrift connection errors: "TSocket::open() connect() <Host: text-service Port: 9090>: Connection refused" and "Failed to connect text-service-client" across the same timeframe. Multiple repeated connection-refused entries show compose-post-service could not reach text-service, causing orchestration to fail and propagate a 500 to the client. The user-service spans in the trace are short and show no errors, indicating user-service is not the root cause.

final_report.root_cause: text-service was unavailable / not listening on its Thrift port (9090) during the incident. compose-post-service attempts to open Thrift connections to text-service received immediate TCP 'Connection refused' errors, causing compose-post orchestration to fail and propagate an HTTP 500 back through nginx-thrift.
final_report.evidence_summary: Trace 028ef016097347d3 (nginx-thrift) shows /wrk2-api/post/compose returned error=true with http.status_code=500. compose-post-client spans were long (~3.24s) matching the failed request. compose-post-service logs (same timeframe) contain repeated Thrift/TTransport errors: "TSocket::open() connect() <Host: text-service Port: 9090>: Connection refused" and "ClientPool.h:114:Pop Failed to connect text-service-client" indicating immediate TCP refusals (not timeouts). text-service pod logs show only initial startup lines and no evidence it accepted connections or served requests. Correlation of the trace and logs yields a sustained failure window where compose-post could not reach text-service, causing the compose flow to error and nginx-thrift to return 500.
final_report.investigation_summary: Priority 1 and 2 investigations were completed. Steps taken: retrieved and analyzed trace 028ef016097347d3; reviewed compose-post-service logs (important tail) and text-service pod logs; correlated timestamps and errors. Key findings: compose-post-service repeatedly received 'Connection refused' when dialing text-service:9090; user-service spans in the trace were short and error-free, so they are not the cause. The most plausible causal chain is: text-service not listening -> compose-post-service Thrift clients get immediate connection refusals -> compose-post orchestration fails/blocks -> nginx-thrift returns HTTP 500. The evidence is consistent and reproducible across the observed timeframe. No additional investigations are strictly necessary to localize the root cause to text-service unavailability, though checking text-service pod status/events and node-level kubelet logs could provide why text-service stopped/listening (crash, failed bind, crashloop, or deployment scaling).
